section_title: 6. RESPONSES TO HALT LAND DEGRADATION AND TO RESTORE DEGRADED LAND
summary: This document provides a comprehensive list of references for Chapter 6 of the IPBES assessment report, which focuses on responses to halt land degradation and restore degraded land. The references cover a wide range of topics including sustainable land management, agroforestry, soil conservation, biodiversity restoration, and economic valuation of ecosystem services.
